description: This file contains utility functions for handling Kubernetes group/version strings, including parsing, version comparison, and group version info generation.

methods.name: ToGroupVersion
methods.description: Parses a 'group/version' string into a GroupVersion struct, handling errors for unexpected formats.

methods.name: sortableSliceOfVersions.Len
methods.description: Returns the length of the version slice.

methods.name: sortableSliceOfVersions.Swap
methods.description: Swaps two elements in the version slice.

methods.name: sortableSliceOfVersions.Less
methods.description: Compares two version strings to determine order, considering stability and semantic versioning.

methods.name: defaultVersion
methods.description: Determines the default (latest) version from a list of PackageVersion objects.

methods.name: ToGroupVersionInfo
methods.description: Generates group version info objects for generator use, based on group and version data.

methods.name: ToGroupInstallPackages
methods.description: Creates install package info for each group, based on default version.
